purpose: Author-designed educational cases, not clinical or external validation. Values and margins are arbitrary.
selection: Deliberately selected failure modes and boundary cases, not a representative sample or held-out benchmark.

cases.title: Current research: evidence is not measured
cases.explanation: The current MVA proposal has no biological measurements or justified margins.

cases.title: All scoped requirements met
cases.explanation: Even this invented all-pass example permits further preclinical review only.

cases.title: Benefit with unacceptable recovery injury
cases.explanation: An apparent benefit cannot compensate for a valid injury signal.

cases.title: Nonsignificant injury is not proven safe
cases.explanation: The injury interval includes unacceptable harm even though it crosses zero.

cases.title: Meaningful benefit excluded
cases.explanation: A valid interval excludes the chosen target in this context; this is not universal inefficacy.

cases.title: Benefit is too imprecise
cases.explanation: The interval spans the target. This is inconclusive, not evidence that the drug cannot work.

cases.title: Failed assay with an unfavorable result
cases.explanation: A failed control prevents a biological conclusion from this assay.

cases.title: Confirmation plan changed after results
cases.explanation: An exploratory result cannot silently become locked confirmation.

cases.title: Unqualified tissue context
cases.explanation: Evidence from one tissue cannot automatically qualify a different tissue.

cases.title: The tested mechanism prerequisite fails
cases.explanation: Stop this mechanistic branch; do not infer that every alternative mechanism fails.

cases.title: Drug and genetic deficit measured separately
cases.explanation: Separate profiles cannot show a drug effect inside deficient cells.

cases.title: Exposure bridge missing
cases.explanation: Nominal culture concentration cannot establish unbound tissue exposure.

cases.title: Cells counted as independent cultures
cases.explanation: Nested cells do not supply independently treated biological replicates.

cases.title: Only surviving cells counted
cases.explanation: Unknown fate of enrolled cells can hide harm or failed divisions.

cases.title: Benefit margin not justified
cases.explanation: An invented or absent benefit threshold cannot qualify a biological result.

cases.title: Observed safety trigger before attribution
cases.explanation: Stop advancement for safety review while attribution remains unresolved.

cases.title: Benefit interval touches the target
cases.explanation: The lower bound must exceed the target; equality does not pass.

cases.title: Injury interval touches the bound
cases.explanation: The upper injury bound must exclude unacceptable harm; equality does not pass.

denominator_example.limit: Mutually exclusive invented first-window categories; later daughter fate is a separate endpoint. Missingness bounds are not confidence intervals.
